newsitem.title: FRANCE: TAT, Air Liberte present plan to group activity.
newsitem.headline: TAT, Air Liberte present plan to group activity.

text.p: British Airways' French subsidiaries, TAT and Air Liberte, said on Monday that a plan to group the activites of the two airlines in France from April had been presented to staff works councils today.
"The main objective of this operation is to be able to group, as soon as possible, the commercial activities of the two companies in the French market," the two companies said in a joint statement.
They also said in the statement that the plan aimed to identify which areas of synergy between the two companies could be divided between the two airlines.
